questions.question: A wise father tells his son to hold on to sound judgment and discernment. What will they be to his soul?
A wise father tells his son not to fear sudden danger. What reason does he give?

answers.text: The LORD will be his confidence
He will see it coming early
He is strong enough to face it

questions.question: A wise father says it is fine to tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, even when you already have the means to help today. True or false?
A wise father teaches that the LORD mocks the mockers. Who does the LORD give grace to?
